source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of recombinant DNA technology (PDF 155-156).

blocks.text: Recombinant DNA technology ka matlab hai mukhtalif zariyon (sources) ke DNA molecules ko kaatna (cutting), jorna (splicing) aur mila kar aik hybrid (mila jula) molecule banana. Is mein is recombinant DNA (rDNA) ko kisi host (mezbaan jandar, maslan bacteria) mein dalna bhi shamil hai, taa ke naye genetic milaap (combinations) ya khaas proteins ban sakein.

blocks.explanation: Do ya zyada mukhtalif zariyon ke DNA ko kaat kar aur jor kar banaya gaya aik hybrid DNA molecule (rDNA).

items: rDNA: mukhtalif zariyon ka DNA kaat kar aur jor kar bana aik hybrid molecule.
rDNA host (jaise bacteria) mein dala jata hai taa ke naye genetic milaap ya khaas proteins banein.
